We obsess over customer experience and strive for constant innovation, with the goal of helping companies and developers build a faster, safer, and more reliable internet. Over 85,000+ customers have already joined us in our mission Together, we can create the internet everyone deserves—no matter where in the world they are. Trustpilot Supercharging the internet since 2015 bunny.net started in 2014 with a simple idea: helping developers deliver content without breaking the bank. From there, it became a much more ambitious vision to help shape the internet. Our mission It’s our mission to help make the internet hop faster! By that, we mean building a faster, safer, and more reliable internet for billions of people worldwide. Our vision To build a genuinely global network driven by constant innovation that helps companies hop ahead and empowers developers to create the internet of tomorrow. Our main core value We are connected by 4 core values, but our main one is relentless innovation. Every ambitious vision has humble beginnings Every story, no matter how small or large, has a beginning. While our vision has changed and grown, our beginnings were quite humble. What hasn’t changed is our commitment to solving problems and always putting the customer first from the moment you sign up. Read Our Full Story 85,000+ Active Customers 1.5 million Powered Websites 650+ Billion Delivered Monthly Requests We hop by our core values The bunny.net team is connected by 4 bunny values to help build a better tomorrow. Dare to build the unimaginable. Hop higher every time We do it all as a team , and have fun along the way We help our customers hop ahead Stationed in Europe but present all around the world bunny.net was built by combining exceptional talent from around the globe. While our home is in Europe, our warrens are present worldwide. Do you want to help make the internet hop faster? Join us. Australia Bulgaria Brazil Canada Croatia Costa Rica Czech Republic El Salvador France Germany Greece Ireland Lithuania Netherlands Paraguay Poland Portugal Philippines Serbia Slovenia Sweden Thailand Ukraine United States United Kingdom Our Bunny milestones How the idea of Bunny CDN was born Struggling with CDN costs, our founder, Dejan, came up with the initial idea for a fast, powerful, yet affordable CDN to help others accelerate their content. January 2012 Bunny CDN beta finally launched The idea turned into a vision to disrupt the CDN market. After 3 years of hard work and sleepless nights, Bunny CDN entered its first beta stage. October 2015 We reached 100,000+ active pull zones It took a few years for things to take off, but we were growing at a nice pace. By the end of 2020, we reached the 1st major milestone: 100k pull zones! December 2020 A bigger vision with a new name to match A simple idea of building a great CDN turned into a new ambitious vision to help shape the future of the internet and make it hop faster. January 2021 A million sites hopping with bunny.net The bunnies are taking over the internet! In August 2022, over 1 million websites were hopping with bunny.net, and we're getting ready to grow even faster.
